scenes.label: Meet Rohan
scenes.title: One last level!
scenes.caption: Meet Rohan. He's spent all week building a moon base in his favourite game. He's so excited to show his friends! His password? Rohan one two three. Easy to remember... but easy for someone else to guess, too.
scenes.dialogue: My friends are going to love this!

scenes.label: The surprise
scenes.title: Someone got into my account!
scenes.caption: The next day, Rohan can't sign in. Someone guessed his easy password and changed it. Now he can't reach his moon base. Rohan feels upset. If this happens to you, tell a trusted adult. You don't have to fix it alone.
scenes.dialogue: My moon base… I can’t get in.

scenes.label: Get help
scenes.title: Let’s get your account back.
scenes.caption: Rohan tells his mum. Together, they use the game's official account recovery steps. They get his account back, change the password, and sign out other sessions. Now, let's help Rohan make a password that's harder to guess.

scenes.label: Build a better key
scenes.title: Words you know. A secret to protect.
scenes.caption: Let's try words Rohan knows: Mango and Rocket. Mango is a fruit. Rocket is a space machine. Join the two tiles, keeping the numbers and symbols attached. Now you can read the words inside the password! It is longer than Rohan one two three, and it does not use his name. Numbers and symbols alone cannot fix an easy password. This example is only for practice. Make a different, private password with a trusted adult for a real account.
scenes.dialogue: Mango and Rocket! I know those words.

scenes.label: Add protection
scenes.title: One account. Its own secret.
scenes.caption: Rohan's school account needs its own password. Copying the full game password would mean one stolen password could open both. His mum helps him make a different password and turn on two-step verification where available. That adds another check at sign-in.
scenes.dialogue: My game and school get different passwords.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Back to the moon!
scenes.caption: Rohan can play again, and he is smiling! He knows three things: use a long password that is hard to guess, give each account a different password, and keep it private. A trusted adult can help him make and safely save his real passwords. They can also turn on an extra sign-in check. Never use the passwords from this lesson on a real account. Now help Rohan practise.
